{"candidates":[{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Materialize the filtered route columns before grouping, preserving the original day-of-month predicate, NULL handling, duplicate counts, aliases, and result types.","sql":"WITH filtered_routes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff
  FROM trips
  WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7
)
SELECT pickup, dropoff, COUNT(*) AS trips
FROM filtered_routes
GROUP BY pickup, dropoff"}]}
